title: archkeel-facts protocol 9
description: The source records of a collector reply. Generated from the Rust types.

Section.description: One section of a reply: its name and its records.

ImportData.description:
An import: one record for each statement or bound name (TypeScript, Rust), or for each
imported name (Python, Dart). `script_global` and `script_member` belong to `script_global`.

ModuleName.description: A module identity: a dotted name (Python, Dart) or `identity::module_identity` (TypeScript).

PackageName.description: The package of a module, or the package of an external dependency.

FactId.description: The id of a source record (`PREFIX-` and 16 hex digits, `identity::stable_id`).

EvidenceClass.description: The evidence class of a source record. A source record is a fact or an UNKNOWN gap.

Area.description:
The area of a record. One concept can have two areas: an import is `source` in TypeScript
and Rust, and `dependencies` in Python and Dart.

EvidenceId.description: The id of one cited source location (`EVD-…`, `identity::evidence_id`).

lexical_parent_id.description: The id of a source record (`PREFIX-` and 16 hex digits, `identity::stable_id`).

ClassData.description: A class, an interface, an enum or a mixin declaration.

RelationshipKind.description: How a class relates to a base declaration.

Status.description: How far a call, a reference or a selector is resolved.

MemberKind.description: The members that a member inventory lists (`facts.MemberKind`).

InventoryStatus.description: Whether a member inventory lists every member (`facts.InventoryStatus`).

lexical_parent_id.description: The id of a source record (`PREFIX-` and 16 hex digits, `identity::stable_id`).

CallableData.description: A function or a method and its signature.

ValueData.description: A constant, a type alias or another named binding of a value.

Literal.description: A written constant: a Python or Dart literal of one of the JSON scalar types.

CallData.description: A call site and the targets that it resolves to.

ReferenceData.description: A reference to a name and the targets that it resolves to.

Use.description: How a reference uses its target.

SourceRoleData.description: The role of a source binding at one location (Python).

BindingData.description: A binding that a module exports (TypeScript).

UnusedBindingData.description: A parameter or a local name that is never read (Python).

ConstructData.description: A written construct that a rule can forbid.

ConstructForm.description: The written form of a construct or of a numeric operand (Python).

NumericOperandData.description: A numeric operand and its proof (Python).

Proof.description: Whether a numeric operand is proven.

Signal.description: The typing signal of a record of `typing_signals`; the text equals the kind of the record.

GapData.description: An UNKNOWN gap of the coverage or of the `unknowns` section.

ResolutionDimension.description: What a source resolution gap leaves unknown.

Kind.description:
The kind of a record. The section of the record decides its data type (`sections`).
`ExceptionGap` replaces the open kind of protocol 9: there, the kind of an analyzer failure
is the name of the exception class (`SyntaxError`). The name is a field of the record.

oneOf.description: The parser cannot read a construct of the file.
The analyzer stopped on the file with an exception (`ExceptionGap`).
The file cannot be read, or it is over the size limit.
The path of the file gives no module identity.
The specifier resolves to no file and no package.
The specifier is computed, so it cannot be resolved.
A setting that decides resolution is not observed.
Package metadata that decides resolution is not observed.
The file that the runtime loads is not proven.
A `require` call is shadowed or not proven.
The target is outside the selected source scope, or it is an excluded test source.
The collector does not examine this kind of dependency, for example script globals.

ReasonCode.description: Why a fact is UNKNOWN. One code covers one cause; the message names the file or the value.

oneOf.description: Shipped in the Archkeel wheel and pinned by its code digest.
Configured by the user. Its verdicts are capped at UNKNOWN.
